correctness.rationale: The turn-flip-move ant state space has 2^12*12*4=196608 states. Each transition has a unique inverse, found by backing up the final direction, recovering the preflip bit and old heading, so the finite full map is a permutation and every state is immediately periodic. Independent full-state enumeration rebuilt and traversed all 196608 states, obtaining 2480 cycles, 20 distinct periods, minimum 16 and maximum 312; all periods divisible by 8 and period-weighted total 196608. All 48 translations and axis-sign operations with color complement for reversing orientation commute with the rule. Classifying temporal cycles under these symmetries reproduced exactly 74 types and the complete 20-row count table, including 18 types among 564 period-72 cycles and two types among 96 longest cycles. This is exhaustive for the fixed finite torus, not for other dimensions.

value.rationale: A 3-by-4 torus is the first unequal-sided torus with at least three sites in both directions, making it a natural finite benchmark. The 20 temporal periods refine into 74 geometric cycle types; even a fixed period (72) splits into 18 distinct types. These are exact complete finite dynamical invariants, independent of claims about larger lattices.

limitations: Only exact 3×4 untwisted torus with flip-then-move and all 12 labelled board bits; no infinite-grid, other sizes or twisted-boundary conclusion.
The entire 196608-state set is finite and fully enumerated, so exhaustive finite computation is a legitimate proof at this size.
residual_risks: Unindexed computational notebooks or independent complete 3×4 torus enumerations could duplicate the exact 2480/74 class table.
Geometric symmetry group is the specified 48 commuting rule maps, not all transformations of the state set or time reversal.
